## 📊 ISO 42001 vs ISO 27001 cost


ISO 27001 certification runs about $25,000 to $90,000 in year one. ISO 42001 reuses the same management-system structure, so when you build it on an existing ISO 27001 ISMS the incremental cost is roughly $10,000 to $30,000 for the AI-specific controls and audit scope. Certified standalone, ISO 42001 lands in a similar range to ISO 27001. Automating the ISO 27001 base first with Strac Comply (from $4,995 per year) is what lowers the ISO 42001 add-on.


## 📉 Why ISO 42001 costs what it does


ISO 42001:2023 is the AI management system standard. It reuses the ISO 27001 structure, so the information-security foundation is a shared cost, then adds AI-specific controls: AI risk management, governance of the data flowing into AI systems, and transparency. The accredited certification body charges a Stage 1 and Stage 2 audit fee, with annual surveillance audits after. See[ISO 27001 certification cost](https://www.strac.io/blog/iso-27001-certification-cost) for the foundation, and our[ISO 42001 certification](https://www.strac.io/blog/iso-42001-certification) guide.

### How much does ISO 42001 certification cost in 2026?


ISO 42001 certification cost typically runs about $20,000 to $70,000 or more in year one, across readiness, AI management system documentation, the certification-body Stage 1 and Stage 2 audit, and staff time. It scales with company size and the number of AI systems in scope. Strac reduces the readiness, AI-data-control, and staff-time portions; the accredited audit itself is a separate fee.


### Is ISO 42001 the same as ISO 27001?


No. ISO 27001 is the information-security management standard; ISO 42001 is the AI management system standard that builds on the same structure. Most organizations certify ISO 27001 first, then add ISO 42001 for AI governance, which is why the two cost conversations overlap.
